title: Make standard s-go-no-library-panic pass
body: Outcome: `krn standards check --record s-go-no-library-panic` no longer fails s-go-no-library-panic.

Why: adoption found this reflex standard failing: exit 1 from bad=$(git ls-files '*.go' | grep -vE '(_test\.go$|(^|/)(vendor|testdata|cmd|tools|examples?)/)' | while IFS= read -r f; do grep -qE '^package main$'...
Files: the files the failing check names (run the Proof command).
